method: DataForSEO Merchant Amazon Products (task_post + task_get/advanced), US (location 2840), en_US, depth 60, 140 buyer-phrased seeds in 28 categories; 'guitar accessories kit' returned no results (139 seeds with data). Organic and sponsored listings kept, deduped by ASIN per seed. Premium = price_from >= $60. premium_units_month = sum of Amazon's 'bought in past month' badge over premium listings. Kit = title matches kit/set/bundle/system/combo/starter/N-piece. Brand read from titles by hand for the top seeds (title-first-word guesses in proven_premium_items are approximate).

seed_table.top_brands: PetSafe (ScoopFree tray refills 20K/mo alone), many no-name auto boxes, PETKIT, Neakasa
seed_table.exclusion: fail: oversize, motorized pet-safety risk, high return complexity; refill trays are PetSafe-proprietary
fail: dominated by tool majors, heavy, lithium batteries on power tools
risky: brand-led, needs cellular data plans; hunting niche
fail: one giant brand, lithium, electronics

seed_table.top_brands: Sterilite, Amazon Basics, IRIS, REIBII, Craftsman
seed_table.exclusion: fail: oversize/heavy steel shelving and bins
fail: brand-led electronics, lithium in wireless mics
risky: brand-led electronics; wired mic kits avoid lithium
pass: watch oversize (24x33 in boards, 10-25 lb) and freight cost
pass with flags: mains appliance (UL/ETL), motor QC

seed_table.top_brands: Theragun/Therabody, RENPHO, Hyperice, Bob and Brad
seed_table.exclusion: fail: big brands, health-claim pull, lithium
pass with flags: same products as dog grooming vacuum
fail: shooting rests/gun clamps are weapon accessories; Meta ad restrictions
pass with flags: crowded, electronics returns, lithium on wireless models
fail: really home cookware; food contact; one brand

seed_table.top_brands: TYMO, ELLA BELLA, Shark, many unbranded 6-in-1 air stylers
seed_table.exclusion: risky: heat appliance safety, Dyson Airwrap patent disputes on dupes
fail: one dominant brand plus Amazon
risky: lithium probes, food contact, app-dependent
fail: one dominant brand, lithium/charging electronics

seed_table.top_brands: Back Seat Extender (Shark Tank), URPOWER, several unbranded hard-bottom extenders
seed_table.exclusion: pass: check Shark Tank brand's patent; bulky but light
fail: one brand, lithium flashlights, blades
mixed: results are desks and power strips

seed_table.top_brands: one 16x16 pizza steel seller (94%), HexClad, Ooni
seed_table.exclusion: fail: 17-27 lb steel slab, single seller

seed_table.top_brands: Bambu Lab, Snapmaker, Fanttik, SUNLU, Creality
seed_table.exclusion: pass for accessory/consumable kits; printers themselves fail

seed_table.top_brands: Rapsodo, TRS, Orange Whip, Garmin, unbranded
seed_table.exclusion: pass with patent check (Orange Whip, Divot Board are patented)
pass with flags: mains electrical, water
pass with flags: solvent chemicals (limited-quantity hazmat shipping, SDS), durability claims

seed_table.top_brands: TRS, Orange Whip, WHYGOLF, Divot Board, 13UnderGolf
G&J's, Breville, many unbranded whiskey smoker kits
seed_table.exclusion: pass with flags: ship torch without butane (hazmat), skip glassware
pass: small motor electronics, noise-related returns
pass: long roll carton; Perfect Practice design check

new_candidate_ideas.idea: Adult jigsaw puzzle station (tilting/rotating board with sorting drawers and cover)
new_candidate_ideas.why_sales_prove_it: Two seeds, 'puzzle table' and 'puzzle board with drawers', together show ~27,600 premium units/month (floor, deduped across both seeds) across 66 premium listings at $64-$225. ALL4JIG 1500pc rotating board with 4 drawers B09WTSKMVW $71.99, 5K+/mo, 9.8K reviews; ALL4JIG 2000pc $79.99 2K+; tilting+rotating 2-in-1 board $79.99 800+; puzzle table with wheels/drawers/cover B0D9PTR7FV $172.99 700+; JoyBerri table B0CP8FC963 $125.99-$179.99 600-1K+; metal legged 1500pc table $154.99 500+. Many sellers besides ALL4JIG at $90-$210 each moving 200-800/mo.
new_candidate_ideas.kit_concept: Tilting+rotating board with 6 drawers and hard cover, plus sorting trays, a clip-on LED light bar, glue-and-frame finishing kit, and one premium 1000pc puzzle.
new_candidate_ideas.reorder_path: Puzzles (monthly or curated club), custom photo puzzles, frames, glue sheets, sorting trays.
new_candidate_ideas.software_edge: Custom photo-to-puzzle builder with live preview; 'puzzle passport' tracker; quiz to size the board to the puzzles they buy.
new_candidate_ideas.risks: Oversize carton (25x34 in, 10-25 lb) so US warehouse freight is high; ALL4JIG holds ~60% of premium units in the board seed and many factory clones exist; Q4 gifting seasonality; wood/MDF quality returns.

new_candidate_ideas.idea: Dog back-seat extender and car travel kit
new_candidate_ideas.why_sales_prove_it: 'dog car seat cover' seed: 13,000 premium units/month (floor), top seller share only 36%. Back Seat Extender for Dogs (as seen on Shark Tank) B0DSK22N1J $169.99 3K+/mo; URPOWER hard-bottom PU leather extender $65.99 2K+ (46.9K reviews); unbranded hard-bottom extenders at $93.49 1K+, $69.98 1K+, $69.99 1K+.
new_candidate_ideas.kit_concept: Hard-bottom extender (fits most back seats) plus seatbelt tether, door guards, collapsible bowl and a fur-removal tool.
new_candidate_ideas.reorder_path: Replacement washable liners, second-car set, pet hair tools, travel bowls, seat protectors for the front.
new_candidate_ideas.software_edge: Vehicle fit finder (make/model/year to size and photos), road-trip packing checklist.
new_candidate_ideas.risks: The Shark Tank brand may hold a design patent: check. Bulky but light carton. Fit-related returns. Many hard-bottom clones from the same factories.

new_candidate_ideas.reorder_path: Clipper blades, filters, dust-cup liners, attachments per breed.
new_candidate_ideas.software_edge: Breed-based grooming schedule and attachment picker; reminder emails for blade and filter replacement.

notes: Limitations: bought_past_month is Amazon's bucketed lower bound (50+, 100+, 1K+, 10K+ etc.), so 1000 means 'at least 1,000'; sums are floors, not totals. About a quarter of listings show no badge. Only page 1 (~60 listings) per seed, Amazon US only, one snapshot on 2026-11-13 (Q4 gifting season inflates gift categories such as cocktail smokers, puzzle tables, watch winders). price_from can be the lowest variant. Variant listings share review counts across sizes/colours, so reviews are per parent ASIN. Amazon volume proves demand at a price, not that a new Meta-funded DTC store can win it at $39-48 CPA. All figures are ESTIMATED (third-party, DataForSEO, checked 2026-11-13). Patent notes are from general knowledge and must be checked before shortlisting.
